pairs: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
The Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Anima quæ peccaverit,
The soul who will have sinned,
et contempto Domino,
and, despising the Lord,
negaverit proximo suo depositum quod fidei ejus creditum fuerat,
will have denied to his neighbor the deposit which he had entrusted to his safekeeping,
vel vi aliquid extorserit,
or who will have extorted anything by force,
aut calumniam fecerit,
or who will have made a false accusation,
sive rem perditam invenerit, et inficians insuper pejeraverit,
or who will have found a lost thing and then also withheld it by swearing falsely,
et quodlibet aliud ex pluribus fecerit, in quibus solent peccare homines,
or who will have done any other of the many things by which men usually sin:
convicta delicti,
being convicted of the offense, he shall restore
reddet omnia, quæ per fraudem voluit obtinere,
all that he wanted to obtain by fraud,
integra, et quintam insuper partem domino cui damnum intulerat.
the whole plus an additional fifth part, to the owner against whom he brought the damage.
Pro peccato autem suo offeret arietem immaculatum de grege,
Then, on behalf of his sin, he shall offer an immaculate ram from the flock,
et dabit eum sacerdoti,
and he shall give it to the priest,
juxta æstimationem mensuramque delicti:
according to the estimation and measure of the offense.
qui rogabit pro eo coram Domino,
And he shall pray for him in the sight of the Lord,
et dimittetur illi pro singulis quæ faciendo peccavit.
and he shall be released from any one of those things that he did when he sinned.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Præcipe Aaron
Instruct Aaron and his sons:
et filiis ejus:
This is the law of a holocaust.
Hæc est lex holocausti:
It shall be burned upon the altar,
cremabitur in altari tota nocte usque mane:
all night until morning.
ignis ex eodem altari erit.
The fire shall be from the same altar.
Vestietur tunica sacerdos et feminalibus lineis:
The priest shall be vested with the tunic and the linen undergarments.
tolletque cineres,
And he shall take up the ashes of that which the devouring fire has consumed,
quos vorans ignis exussit,
and,
et ponens juxta altare,
placing them next to the altar,
spoliabitur prioribus vestimentis,
he shall strip off his former vestments,
indutusque aliis,
and being clothed with others,
efferret eos extra castra,
he shall carry them beyond the camp,
et in loco mundissimo usque ad favillam consumi faciet.
and he shall cause them to be consumed, even to glowing embers, in a very clean place.
Ignis autem in altari semper ardebit,
But the fire on the altar shall burn always,
quem nutriet sacerdos subjiciens ligna mane per singulos dies,
for the priest shall nourish it by placing wood under it each day in the morning.
et imposito holocausto,
And, laying down the holocaust,
desuper adolebit adipes pacificorum.
he shall burn the fat of the peace offerings upon it.
Ignis est iste perpetuus, qui numquam deficiet in altari.
This is the perpetual fire which shall never fail upon the altar.
Hæc est lex sacrificii et libamentorum,
This is the law of the sacrifice and the libations,
quæ offerent filii Aaron coram Domino,
which the sons of Aaron shall offer in the sight of the Lord,
et coram altari.
and before the altar.
Tollet sacerdos pugillum similæ,
The priest shall take a handful of fine wheat flour,
quæ conspersa est oleo,
which has been sprinkled with oil,
et totum thus,
and all the frankincense,
quod super similam positum est:
which has been placed upon the flour,
adolebitque illud in altari in monimentum odoris suavissimi Domino:
and he shall burn it upon the altar as a memorial of most sweet odor to the Lord.
reliquam autem partem similæ comedet Aaron cum filiis suis,
And the remaining portion of the flour, Aaron shall eat with his sons, without leaven.
absque fermento: et comedet in loco sancto atrii tabernaculi.
And he shall eat it in the holy place, in the atrium of the tabernacle.
Ideo autem non fermentabitur,
Yet for this reason,
quia pars ejus in Domini offertur incensum.
it shall not be leavened,
Sanctum sanctorum erit,
because part of it is offered as an incense of the Lord.
sicut pro peccato
The Holy of holies shall it be,
atque delicto.
just as what is offered on behalf of sin and of transgression.
Mares tantum stirpis Aaron comedent illud.
Only the males of the stock of Aaron shall eat it.
Legitimum ac sempiternum erit in generationibus vestris de sacrificiis Domini:
This shall be an everlasting ordinance in your generations concerning the sacrifices of the Lord.
omnis qui tetigerit illa, sanctificabitur.
All who will touch these shall be sanctified.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Hæc est oblatio Aaron,
This is the oblation of Aaron
et filiorum ejus,
and of his sons,
quam offerre debent Domino in die unctionis suæ.
which they must offer to the Lord in the day of their anointing.
Decimam partem ephi offerent similæ in sacrificio sempiterno,
They shall offer a tenth part of an ephah of fine wheat flour as a perpetual sacrifice,
medium ejus mane,
half of it in the morning,
et medium ejus vespere:
and half of it in the evening.
quæ in sartagine oleo conspersa frigetur.
It shall be sprinkled with oil and fried in a frying pan.
Offeret autem eam calidam in odorem suavissimum Domino
Then it shall be offered hot, as a most sweet odor to the Lord,
sacerdos, qui jure patri successerit,
by the priest who by law succeeds his father.
et tota cremabitur in altari.
And it shall be entirely burned on the altar.
Omne enim sacrificium sacerdotum igne consumetur,
For every sacrifice of the priest shall be consumed by fire;
nec quisquam comedet ex eo.
neither shall anyone eat from it.
Locutus est autem Dominus ad Moysen,
Then the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere Aaron et filiis ejus:
Say to Aaron and his sons:
Ista est lex hostiæ pro peccato:
This is the law of the victim for sin.
in loco ubi offertur holocaustum,
In the place where the holocaust is offered,
immolabitur coram Domino.
it shall be immolated in the sight of the Lord.
Sanctum sanctorum est.
It is the Holy of holies.
Sacerdos, qui offert, comedet eam in loco sancto,
The priest who offers it shall eat it in the holy place,
in atrio tabernaculi.
in the atrium of the tabernacle.
Quidquid tetigerit carnes ejus, sanctificabitur.
Whatever will touch its flesh shall be sanctified.
Si de sanguine illius vestis fuerit aspersa,
If a garment will be sprinkled with its blood,
lavabitur in loco sancto.
it shall be washed in a holy place.
Vas autem fictile,
Then the earthen vessel,
in quo cocta est,
in which it was soaked,
confringetur;
shall be broken.
quod si vas æneum fuerit,
But if the vessel will be of brass,
defricabitur,
it shall be scoured
et lavabitur aqua.
and washed with water.
Omnis masculus de genere sacerdotali vescetur de carnibus ejus,
Every male of priestly descent shall feed on its flesh,
quia Sanctum sanctorum est.
because it is the Holy of holies.
Hostia enim quæ cæditur pro peccato,
For the victim that is slain for sin,
cujus sanguis infertur in tabernaculum testimonii ad expiandum in sanctuario,
whose blood is carried into the tabernacle of the testimony, for expiation in the Sanctuary,
non comedetur,
shall not be eaten,
sed comburetur igni.
but it shall be consumed by fire.
